mapping: Case-level, duplicate findings/alerts collapse. WSS frozen prefix selector: FAIL > WARNING > PASS; missing=ERROR. ZAP mapped alert on root URL only (cookies root or /api/login), riskcode>=1 => FAIL, else completed imported evidence => NO_ALERT. NO_ALERT is operational negative, not proof of safety. Cookie SameSite=None 10054-2 is advice and excluded. CSP 10055 refs 4/5/7/9/10/13 only; 10038 missing/report-only included; other CSP advice excluded. Other selected plugin IDs all positive risk alerts included.
truth: Original unchanged ground truth. vulnerable FAIL=TP, PASS/NO_ALERT=FN; safe FAIL=FP, PASS/NO_ALERT=TN. WARNING=ABSTAIN. Unknown excluded, outputs reported. Error excluded and reported.
metrics: Primary known cases only. precision TP/(TP+FP), conditional recall TP/(TP+FN), coverage (TP+FP+FN+TN)/known; vulnerable detection TP/all vulnerable also reported. Zero denominator null. Supplemental preference-cookie policy case separate.
evidence: Capture HTTPConnection responses actually consumed by WSS; duplicate response fields and base64 body in HAR. Import into ZAP importHar sendRequests=false after fixture closes. Require GET bytes=Content-Length and imported message count=HAR count, queue empty and no running scan. No spider/active scan. No fake HTTPS.
timing: WSS run_scan wall time includes HTTP acquisition; ZAP import+queue+running wait wall time excludes acquisition and startup, includes polling overhead. Not a speed ranking. ZAP persistent JVM per batch; per-trial sampled RSS and batch process peak; WSS fresh process including fixture/imports. Single repetition, no inferential significance.
policy: none is equal-input primary; headers passes existing P1/header requirements only to WSS, separately reported. ZAP has no equivalent service contract input. Policy supplement excluded from primary.
